title: Water Challenge
description: In this mod, players drown on air (and in water). Can you beat the game, even under water?
body: # Waterworld Challenge In this mod, players drown on air (and in water). Can you beat the game, even under water? ## Features ### 💧 Inverse Drowning Players drown also on air. * **Grace Period:** By default, you have **30 ticks** before taking air-drowning damage. * **Turtle Helmet:** Wearing a Turtle Helmet significantly extends your survival time on land to **300 Ticks**. * **Respiration:** The Respiration enchantment on your helmet reduces the drowning damage taken per second. ### 🪣 Starting Aid Every player receives a **Water Bucket** upon joining for the first time and after every respawn. ### 🔥 Blaze Spawner Transformation All hostile spawners are automatically converted into **Blaze Spawners**. ## Credits Developed by **Eckelsoft**.
